product_metadata.title: PREXTEX 6pcs Black-Feathered Small Crows Halloween Decorations | Outdoor&Indoor Decor | Fake Bird, Halloween Birds, Scary Ravens, Decorative Crows, Raven | Home, Fence, Porch, Tree, Party Decoration
features: SET - This includes 6 black-feathered small foam crows.
APPEARANCE - The crows have a life-like appearance, realistic and scary enough as a spooky prop or decor.
MEASUREMENT - Each crow measures approximately 4 inches tall and 6 inches from beak to tail feathers.
EASY TO INSTALL - Each crow has wires on its feet to easily attach to branches, fences, chair backs, and other surfaces.
GREAT DECORATION - These are great for Halloween, haunted house, themed events, and other occasions!
